text: The text contrasts the thematic presentation of good versus evil in J.R.R. Tolkien's 'The Lord of the Rings' and C.S. Lewis's 'The Chronicles of Narnia'. Both works share the prevalent theme of good versus evil. However, they differ in their approach: 'The Lord of the Rings' presents a complex world with a clear distinction between the forces of good and darkness, whereas 'The Chronicles of Narnia' often blurs this line by introducing characters who waver between sides, offering a more nuanced view of morality.
